---
title: "09 - smiDE"
subtitle: "Each cell type's genes between niches, per sample and pooled"
---

```{r}
source("_helpers.R")
source("_figures.R")
sm_f <- find_tab("^smide_meta_summary\\.csv$")
mt_f <- find_tab("^smide_meta\\.csv$")
sm <- read_files(sm_f)
mt <- read_files(mt_f)
cut <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stage_params("de")$smide_fdr %||% config_table()$default[match("smide_fdr", config_table()$name)]))
if (!is.finite(cut)) cut <- 0.05
## One model for the figures, kmeans when it ran, and each niche against the rest ##
model <- if (!is.null(mt) && "kmeans" %in% mt$spatial_model) "kmeans" else if (!is.null(mt)) mt$spatial_model[1] else ""
ovr <- if (!is.null(mt)) {
  mt[spatial_model == model & result_component == "one.vs.rest"][, `:=`(
    log2fc = log_fc / log(2), niche = sub(" vs\\. avg\\.rest$", "", contrast)
  )]
}
cell_types <- if (!is.null(ovr)) label_levels(ovr$cell_type, STYLE) else character()
## The per-sample result files, by cell type ##
per_sample <- function() {
  f <- published_tables()
  f[grepl("/09_de/smide/", f) & grepl("__.+_smide_de_results\\.csv$", basename(f))]
}
```

smiDE fits, in each sample, a mixed model of each gene in each focal cell type, comparing the niches the cells sit in. The samples' effects are then pooled per gene. The figures use the `r if (nzchar(model)) model else "first"` spatial model and each niche against the rest.

```{r}
page_top(
  stages = "de",
  Input = "The spatial object, its <code>celltype_column</code>, the niche column <code>smide_groupvar</code> and the focal cell types <code>smide_celltypes</code>.",
  Method = "smiDE GLMMs per sample and cell type, with neighbour expression within <code>smide_radius</code> as a covariate, for each <code>smide_spatial_model</code>. Then a fixed-effect, inverse-variance pool across samples, with Cochran's Q and I2 for how much the samples differ.",
  Output = "The tables in <code>tables/09_de</code>."
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(render_tree(list(
  "Hits" = function() {
    if (is.null(sm)) return(missing_note("smiDE has not run."))
    fig <- rfig("smide_hits", c(sm_f, RUN$label_colours), function() {
      d <- copy(sm)[, cell_type := factor(cell_type, rev(label_levels(cell_type, STYLE)))]
      ggplot(d, aes(hits, cell_type, fill = result_component)) +
        geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.8) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = stats::setNames(NICHE_COLOURS[seq_along(unique(d$result_component))], sort(unique(d$result_component))), name = NULL) +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) display_name(x, STYLE)) +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.04))) +
        facet_wrap(~spatial_model) +
        labs(x = "Genes below the FDR cutoff", y = NULL) +
        theme_report()
    }, 9, 1.6 + 0.5 * length(unique(sm$cell_type)))
    niches <- if (!is.null(ovr)) {
      rfig("smide_hits_niche", c(mt_f, RUN$label_colours), function() {
        d <- ovr[, .(hits = sum(fdr < cut, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(cell_type, niche)]
        d[, `:=`(cell_type = factor(cell_type, rev(cell_types)), niche = factor(niche, niche_levels(niche)))]
        heat_plot(d, "niche", "cell_type", "hits", name = "Genes") +
          geom_text(aes(label = hits), size = 2.6, colour = "grey20") +
          scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) display_name(x, STYLE))
      }, heat_size(length(unique(ovr$niche)), length(cell_types))[["w"]] + 1, heat_size(length(unique(ovr$niche)), length(cell_types))[["h"]] + 0.5)
    }
    tagList(
      rgallery(list(
        `Genes below the cutoff per cell type, model and comparison` = fig,
        `Genes below the cutoff per cell type and niche, each niche against the rest` = niches
      ), big = TRUE),
      hits_table(sm, csv = sm_f, note = "heterogeneous counts the hits whose samples differ (Cochran's Q). flagged counts those that neighbouring cells may carry.")
    )
  },
  "Volcanoes" = function() {
    if (is.null(ovr)) return(missing_note("No pooled results yet."))
    items <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
      n_n <- length(unique(ovr[cell_type == ct & is.finite(fdr), niche]))
      rfig(paste0("smide_volcano_", ct), mt_f, function() {
        d <- ovr[cell_type == ct]
        d[, niche := factor(niche, niche_levels(niche))]
        volcano_plot(d, "log2fc", "fdr", cut = cut, gene = "target", facet = "niche", flag = "niche_bleed")
      }, 11, 1.4 + 2.6 * ceiling(n_n / 3))
    })
    tagList(
      rpicker(stats::setNames(items, display_name(cell_types, STYLE))),
      tags$p(class = "table-note", "Each niche against the rest. A panel stops a quarter past its largest hit, or at three times the upper quartile of its genes when it has none, and genes past that sit at its edge.")
    )
  },
  "Top genes across niches" = function() {
    if (is.null(ovr)) return(missing_note("No pooled results yet."))
    items <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
      rfig(paste0("smide_heat_", ct), mt_f, function() {
        d <- ovr[cell_type == ct]
        top <- d[fdr < cut][order(fdr)][, unique(target)][seq_len(min(30, length(unique(d[fdr < cut, target]))))]
        if (!length(top)) return(NULL)
        d <- d[target %in% top]
        d[, `:=`(target = factor(target, rev(top)), niche = factor(niche, niche_levels(niche)), hit = fdr < cut)]
        heat_plot(d, "niche", "target", "log2fc", diverging = TRUE, name = "log2 fold\nchange", dot = "hit",
                  limits = c(-1, 1) * max(abs(d$log2fc[d$hit]), na.rm = TRUE))
      }, 6, 8)
    })
    tagList(
      rpicker(stats::setNames(items, display_name(cell_types, STYLE)), empty = "No genes below the cutoff."),
      tags$p(class = "table-note", "The 30 genes with the smallest FDR in each cell type, their log2 fold change in each niche against the rest. A dot: below the cutoff. The colours stop at the largest hit.")
    )
  },
  "Across samples" = function() {
    if (is.null(ovr)) return(missing_note("No pooled results yet."))
    files <- per_sample()
    if (!length(files)) return(missing_note("No per-sample results yet."))
    items <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
      f_ct <- files[grepl(paste0("__", rx(ct), "_smide_de_results\\.csv$"), basename(files))]
      top <- ovr[cell_type == ct & fdr < cut][order(fdr)][seq_len(min(.N, 6))]
      if (!nrow(top) || !length(f_ct)) return(character())
      rfig(paste0("smide_forest_", ct), c(mt_f, f_ct), function() {
        want <- c("contrast", "ratio", "SE", "target", "result_component", "sample", "spatial_model")
        s <- rbindlist(lapply(f_ct, function(f) {
          x <- as_numbers(fread(f, header = TRUE, select = intersect(want, names(fread(f, nrows = 0L, header = TRUE)))))
          x[result_component == "one.vs.rest" & spatial_model == model & target %in% top$target & !is.na(ratio)]
        }), fill = TRUE)
        s <- merge(s, top[, .(contrast, target)], by = c("contrast", "target"))
        ## Sample fits whose 95% interval stays within 10 log2 units each side ##
        s <- s[ratio > 0 & SE / ratio / log(2) <= 5]
        s[, `:=`(est = log2(ratio), lo = log2(ratio) - 1.96 * SE / ratio / log(2), hi = log2(ratio) + 1.96 * SE / ratio / log(2), what = sample)]
        p <- top[, .(contrast, target, est = log_fc / log(2), lo = (log_fc - 1.96 * se) / log(2), hi = (log_fc + 1.96 * se) / log(2), what = "pooled")]
        d <- rbind(s[, .(contrast, target, est, lo, hi, what)], p)
        d[, gene := paste0(target, ", ", sub(" vs\\. avg\\.rest$", "", contrast))]
        d[, gene := factor(gene, unique(paste0(top$target, ", ", sub(" vs\\. avg\\.rest$", "", top$contrast))))]
        lv <- c(sample_levels(setdiff(unique(d$what), "pooled")), "pooled")
        d[, what := factor(what, rev(lv))]
        ggplot(d, aes(est, what, colour = what == "pooled")) +
          geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey75") +
          geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), width = 0.25, orientation = "y") +
          geom_point(aes(size = what == "pooled")) +
          scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = WARM, `FALSE` = TEAL), guide = "none") +
          scale_size_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 2.6, `FALSE` = 1.6), guide = "none") +
          facet_wrap(~gene, scales = "free_x") +
          labs(x = "log2 fold change in the niche against the rest, with 95% intervals", y = NULL) +
          theme_report() +
          theme(panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.6, "lines"))
      }, 10, 2 + 2.8 * ceiling(nrow(top) / 3))
    })
    tagList(
      rpicker(stats::setNames(items, display_name(cell_types, STYLE)), empty = "No genes below the cutoff."),
      tags$p(class = "table-note", "The six genes with the smallest FDR in each cell type: each sample's estimate, and the pooled one in red. Sample fits whose 95% interval runs past 10 log2 units each side carry almost no weight in the pool and are left out.")
    )
  },
  "How much the samples differ" = function() {
    if (is.null(ovr) || !"I2" %in% names(ovr)) return(missing_note("No pooled results yet."))
    fig <- rfig("smide_i2", c(mt_f, RUN$label_colours), function() {
      d <- ovr[fdr < cut & is.finite(I2)]
      if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
      d[, cell_type := factor(cell_type, rev(cell_types))]
      ggplot(d, aes(I2, cell_type)) +
        geom_violin(fill = KEPT, colour = NA, scale = "width") +
        geom_jitter(height = 0.15, size = 0.6, colour = TEAL, alpha = 0.5) +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) display_name(x, STYLE)) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
        labs(x = "I2 of the hits (%), the share of their variation that is between samples", y = NULL) +
        theme_report()
    }, 8, 1.4 + 0.45 * length(cell_types))
    rgallery(list(`Between-sample heterogeneity of the hits` = fig), wide = TRUE, empty = "No genes below the cutoff.")
  },
  "Genes" = function() {
    tab("^smide_meta\\.csv$", order = "fdr", note = "Each gene's niche effect pooled across samples. niche_bleed marks genes that neighbouring cells of other types carry far more of inside the niche.")
  },
  "Per sample" = function() {
    f <- per_sample()
    if (!length(f)) return(missing_note("No per-sample smiDE results yet."))
    d <- data.table(
      sample = basename(dirname(f)),
      cell_type = sub("^.+?__(.+)_smide_de_results\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(f)), file = f
    )[order(sample, cell_type)]
    tags$table(
      class = "table table-sm plain",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Sample"), tags$th("Cell type"), tags$th("Results"))),
      tags$tbody(Map(function(s, ct, x) {
        tags$tr(tags$td(s), tags$td(ct), tags$td(tags$a(href = href(x), target = "_blank", basename(x))))
      }, d$sample, d$cell_type, d$file))
    )
  },
  ".pipeline" = function() pipeline_figures(c(figs("09_de", "^smide.+\\.png$", FALSE), figs("09_de/smide", "\\.png$"))),
  "Parameters" = function() {
    params_table(c("smide_groupvar", "smide_celltypes", "smide_radius", "smide_overlap_threshold", "smide_min_detection",
                   "smide_min_cells_per_niche", "smide_family", "smide_spatial_model", "smide_k_prop_n", "smide_comparisons",
                   "smide_fdr", "smide_niche_overlap_flag"), "de")
  }
)))
```
